LOOK: The DPWH has completed the phases 2-5 of rehabilitation of drainage system along G. Araneta Avenue in Quezon City. The agency is on track with its target schedule of completion by February 2026.

With this, DPWH Secretary Dizon hopes that the widespread flooding in the area will be mitigated. 

Dizon also says that the completion of the phase 1 along E. Rodriguez will be done by May 2026. Two 1.5-meter long drainages will also be installed in the area. | @DSampangINQ
